slots.name: official pitches received
slots.sentence: Imax held preliminary talks with potential buyers earlier this year, but as of May hadn't fielded any official pitches, CNBC reported at the time .

slots.name: sale process status
slots.sentence: Imax hasn't hired new bankers and doesn't have a formalized pitch book, according to a person familiar with the company, who spoke on the condition of anonymity to discuss confidential matters.
